commands:
printf %b "Hi,\n
The jail o-a-mail-whois-lines has been started successfully.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | mail -E 'set escape' -s "[Fail2Ban] o-a-mail-whois-lines: started on <fq-hostname>" root

printf %b "Hi,\n
The jail o-a-mail-whois-lines has been stopped.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | mail -E 'set escape' -s "[Fail2Ban] o-a-mail-whois-lines: stopped on <fq-hostname>" root

files.jail.local:
[o-a-mail-whois-lines]
enabled = true
filter =
logpath = /dev/null
backend = polling
action = mail-whois-lines

stderr: fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING No filter set for jail o-a-mail-whois-lines
